articles.title: Planet Formation Relies On Disk Structures Forming Rapidly, New Modelling Reveals
articles.description: Researchers found that while substructures within protoplanetary disks aid in explaining observed dust properties and spectral indices, fully replicating the gas-to-dust ratios in the Lupus star-forming region requires very specific initial disk conditions, suggesting a significant challenge in modelling planet formation.
